name: Tokusatsu
summary: Core subgenres that shape the tokusatsu aesthetic include kaiju (giant monsters) like the Godzilla and Gamera series; superhero narratives such as Kamen Rider and Metal Hero ; Kyodai Hero (giant heroes) like Ultraman and Denkou Choujin Gridman ; and mecha (giant robots) from series like Giant Robo .
description: Core subgenres that shape the tokusatsu aesthetic include kaiju (giant monsters) like the Godzilla and Gamera series; superhero narratives such as Kamen Rider and Metal Hero ; Kyodai Hero (giant heroes) like Ultraman and Denkou Choujin Gridman ; and mecha (giant robots) from series like Giant Robo . Many tokusatsu programs blend these elements, exemplified by the Super Sentai series. Though a significant form of Japanese entertainment, only key properties like Godzilla have achieved widespread international recognition, influencing global cinema and pop culture.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Heroism, justice, humanity's spirit, fight against evil/fascism, appreciation for life, technological wonder

visualDNA.colour: Often vibrant primary colors, metallic sheens, dark monster tones, explosive effects
